title: Attribute Shrine
html:
Intellect Shrine

Shrines are obelisk-like objects randomly found in various dungeons. When clicked the floating obelisk will decend and an area effect will occur. This area effect will grant a 10% boost to a single Attribute for 5 minutes to all players withing the vicinity.

The various shrines can be identified by a carved symbol under the floating obelisk:

  • Agility Shrine - A winged boot
  • Intellect Shrine - An open book
  • Endurance Shrine - A heart
  • Strength Shrine -
